sentences.text: Next, a category that only exists offshore.
Constrained by her draft is International only.
It’s a big ship whose draft, compared with the depth and width of the water, means she really can’t deviate from her course.
You won’t find it in the Inland rules at all.
A vessel is underway if she’s not at anchor, not made fast to the shore, and not aground.
Making way means actually moving through the water under her own power.
So imagine you shut down to drift over a wreck.
You’re not anchored, not tied up, and not aground.
You’re underway, but not making way.
As you’ll see later, both your lights and your fog signals depend on that difference.
